notes.title: Adventurer’s Log #1
notes.content:
Dear adventurers,   

Thank you for your positive response to The Adventures of Lily & Leo. It's been an exciting few days for the whole Cubidoo team! 🐝  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983522/d619abfa3022660decd83e64ea96d70a433b163a.png

We are incredibly grateful to you for taking the time to leave some reviews. Each review helps us a lot!    

We've made a big improvement for our Steam release, which we hope you've noticed: we've added backgrounds to our scenes to make Lily and Leo's world even more colourful and vibrant!  😍  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983522/02427ef1257e8ab9d62f38a137c649634498b92b.png

Thanks also to all the brave explorers who not only searched for Quattro, but also for bugs! 🐞  

Your messages with further suggestions for improvement have reached us and we are doing our best to implement these ideas.   
In the last few days, we have immediately worked on eliminating some of these nasty bugs. 🔨 
 

Version 1.3.7: Improvements   
- File size of the game reduced by 50%  
- Improved performance  
- Labyrinth at the big tree: The puzzle could not be solved. We have found a solution, and the maze is now solvable! (Many thanks to our attentive community for the hint!)    
- Steam Support  
- Minor adjustments and bug fixes  

We will constantly improve Lily & Leo, so don't hesitate to contact us if you have any questions, problems or suggestions. We adventurers have to stick together, right? 👏  

 
Best wishes,  
Your Cubidoo team
